description: Free. Everything an agent needs before generating a subsystem: its boundary contracts (the ports, items, units and rates both sides of each interface state), the interfaces frozen during parallel generation, the functions allocated to it, the requirements on it, its current text, and the baseline id to generate against.

model_id.description: A saved model id (m_ followed by 24 hex digits), as the studio and /v1/repos list them.

ref.description: A branch, commit or baseline (default main).

subsystem_id.description: Qualified name of a package or definition, e.g. "L4Robotaxi::NetworkSwitch".
